tools.name: execute_blender_code
tools.description: Execute ordinary read-only bpy/Python in this session persistent private Blender namespace. NumPy, mathutils BVH, mesh/triangle reading, your own Python computations and cached variables are allowed. Only this scene and your own computations may be read; no fixture sources, management files or scoring data. No scene edits or saving. Image delivery disabled.

tools.name: human_eye_scene_observe
tools.description: Current Blender facts. Task set example: {"include_image":false,"query":{"mode":"task","target":{"name":"A"},"candidates":[{"name":"B"}],"requested_facts":["closed_solid_relation","surface_proximity"]}}. Unknown/duplicate rows remain. Complete penetration/nearest-separated sets require all relevant evidence; otherwise only known subsets are reported. Legacy objects pair/aabb supported. Global surface_nearest instead uses one query.objects selector without focal_id, or focal_id with query={"mode":"surface_nearest"}; session_id and include_image=false required. Complete means global nearest; partial means best-known. scene_revision/fingerprint bind this capture/source/revision; runtime_source_sha256 identifies code. Scene edits expire observations. Goals are caller criteria.

goal.description: Optional caller-supplied task criteria, evaluated separately from execution. Omitted object IDs bind to the selected observation/action pair. These criteria are not independently verified as the human user's intent.

query.description: Selectors use name OR id. Legacy exact_pairs/nearest/top1 use object_ids/max_exact_pairs. nearest needs complete exact nonpenetrating order; top1 may prune by strict outward bounds and reports ties. Unknown/budget-limited proofs do not certify nearest.

objects.description: Legacy task: aabb 1..4 selectors; pair facts two ordered A to B.

candidates.description: 1..3 explicit candidates in request order; one capture with target. Requires closed_solid_relation and surface_proximity; aabb optional.

requested_facts.description: task: closed_solid_relation is zero-tolerance separated/touching/penetrating (positive-volume overlap, including containment) for represented connected closed triangle shells; invalid/ambiguous is unknown. surface_proximity independently gives nonnegative triangle-surface distance, original world witness points and positive-distance A-to-B direction; zero-distance direction is inapplicable. Boundary/nonmanifold counts do not certify solids. Penetrating/contained distances are not separated gaps. pair_relation's escape of A is not surface distance, nearest direction or minimum depth.

operation.description: Registered target reads. mesh_structure: diagnose text or patch images. mesh_surface (local opt-in): diagnose/reference/restore_preview require include_image=false; reference_patch uses a returned opaque patch_ref and optional native images. References are locally trusted; previews do not execute; the original task budget applies.

task_ref.description: Trusted begin handoff, required in local lifecycle mode; selects the active generation without creating or renewing a task.

label_object_ids.description: Current full IDs for image annotation, separate from measurement object_ids: up to six related labels plus A/B. Missing pair/image, occlusion or undersampling is explicit; display only.

alignment_evidence.description: False omits optional face angles and requires include_image=false; strict distance, host rigid-frame and action checks remain.

support_plane_discovery.description: Read-only discovery of bounded original support-plane selectors for the current focal/reference pair. Omit direction for geometry only; no action direction is invented.

native_visual.description: Display policy only; never execution permission. Auto uses a negotiated read-only native host, otherwise the analytical projection. Projection skips negotiation; multiscale requires support. Labels and contact sections require projection.

visual_diagnostic.description: Analytical full-mesh contact section beside natural views; not visibility evidence or action permission.

include_image.description: False returns text evidence without rendering. mesh_structure diagnose requires false and reads only the registered target raw mesh; patch may explicitly request images. Other observation modes retain default true.

scene_delta.description: Optional observation-only snapshot transport. Empty object asks for full resync; a complete base revision and SHA256 enables a delta when worthwhile.

response_detail.description: Optional display projection. Brief preserves measurements, scopes, unknowns and native image bytes while omitting named camera/raster diagnostics. Full is a new current observation, not retrieval of a previous observation. Errors and insufficient savings keep full.

tools.name: human_eye_connection_status
tools.description: Read the live service configuration and connection status without changing the scene.
